drafts.text:
Need is what gets me into the trade too early.
Want is what gets me out of it too late.
Both are me negotiating with a plan that was fine until I needed something from it.
drafts.source: @apodochiHQ's comment ("What if you didn't need the payout?", 241 likes) + Jesus's own reply (203 likes) on the 15K post
drafts.why: The single richest comment exchange on the account right now, 444 combined likes, more than either parent post. Aphorism form keeps it citable.
drafts.why_es: El intercambio de comentarios más rico de la cuenta ahora mismo, 444 likes combinados, más que cualquiera de los dos posts originales. La forma de aforismo lo mantiene citable.

drafts.text:
I know the plan. I still break it the same way, almost every time.
Somebody in the replies told me to put a picture of my kids on my desk so I'd remember why I'm doing this before I click.
Anyone else need something in your face to actually stop you, because knowing better in your head clearly isn't enough?
drafts.source: @LPH733's comment ("put a picture of your kids on your desk... make it count", 35 likes) on the 15K post
drafts.why: On-brand family angle for @TradeDadLog's dad identity. Complaint+question is the confirmed strongest recent-week format for reply volume.
drafts.why_es: Ángulo familiar muy propio de la identidad de papá de @TradeDadLog. Queja+pregunta es el formato más fuerte confirmado de la semana reciente para volumen de respuestas.

drafts.text:
Somebody called it "payout maxxing" in my replies and I haven't stopped thinking about it.
Funny because it's true. Not funny because it's also why the account is gone.
A win isn't proof I'm a genius and a loss isn't proof I'm an idiot. Both are just what happened. I keep forgetting that part.
drafts.source: @jacktradesnq's comment ("payout maxxing", 248 likes, on the 15K post) + @EdmundoFutures's comment (emotional neutrality toward outcomes, 107 likes, on the 4 sep post)
drafts.why: Lighter self-deprecating register that's worked before (12K on the coupon post) while still landing a real point. Rotates format away from confession/aphorism/question.
drafts.why_es: Registro más ligero de autocrítica que ya ha funcionado antes (12K en el post del cupón) sin dejar de aterrizar un punto real. Rota el formato lejos de confesión/aforismo/pregunta.
